resources.string: "Four leaves. One connection.\nYour devices, your shared space."
"A blue-and-pink theme with light, dark, and dynamic color options."
"Use system wallpaper colors on supported Android 12+ devices. Turn off for the blue-and-pink theme, with darker backgrounds and cards in dark mode."
"Dynamic colors are not supported on this device. The blue-and-pink theme is used instead."
"Changing appearance or language reloads the screen without stopping sharing. Unsaved edits may be lost. Diagnostic logs keep their original language."
"SMB sharing requires root access. Notifications show service status and device-wide network speed. Android may still restrict background activity."

"Share only on trusted networks. Guests need no password. Write access allows uploads, edits and deletion. Passwords are encrypted using Android Keystore; Samba uses a private authentication database."

"1. Connect both devices to the same local network.
2. Choose a folder, review access permissions, then start sharing.
3. On Windows use \\device-IP\Share. In iOS Files choose Connect to Server and enter smb://device-IP/Share. These clients normally need port 445.
4. Recent Windows versions may reject guest login. Use an account and password rather than disabling system protections.
5. Stop and restart sharing after changing its configuration."
"This setting is unavailable. Manage PocketShare in Android Settings."
"Connect devices and share files on your local network"
"Start sharing to let devices on the same local network access the selected folder over SMB."
"Device-wide speed, not just sharing · Updated every second"
"Generated from the current settings. Available after sharing starts."
"Enter the address in an SMB-compatible file manager, or scan the QR code with a compatible reader."
"The share is named Share and includes the selected folder and its subfolders."
"Recommended for Windows and iOS Files. Turn off to use a custom port. Both modes require root access."
"Allow devices on the local network to connect without a password. Use only on trusted networks."
"Enter an existing system account on this device, not a new username"
"Not stored in app settings. You may need to re-enter it after the screen reloads or the app reopens."
"Helper components start as needed, so an idle component is not always a fault. Force stopping interrupts related connections; some components may restart automatically."
"View service events and Samba diagnostic logs."
"Shows the last 160 diagnostic log lines. Clearing service events does not delete diagnostic logs."
"No diagnostics yet. Start sharing, then refresh."
"Cannot read component status. Check root access and try again."
"Cannot read diagnostic logs. Check root access and try again."
"Could not read diagnostics · Tap refresh to retry"
"Grant root access before starting SMB sharing."
"Settings saved. Changes apply next time sharing starts."
"Default folder selected. Applies next time sharing starts."

"Restore the default folder and port 4450, enable guest read/write and disable required encryption and directory caching. Files, users, appearance and auto archive settings are kept. Restart sharing to apply."
"Sharing settings reset. Applies next time sharing starts."
"Saved when you leave this page. Changes apply next time sharing starts."

"Correct the highlighted settings and try again."

"Samba 4.24.6: SMB2/SMB3 file sharing and authentication. The server uses GPL v3; some libraries use other licenses.

AndroidX: activity, language, notification and compatibility support; Apache 2.0.
Material Components 1.12.0: native widgets, themes and dynamic colors; Apache 2.0.
ZXing 3.5.3: connection QR codes; Apache 2.0.
Kotlin: application logic and standard library; Apache 2.0.

Native dependencies include talloc/tdb, GnuTLS, OpenSSL, Kerberos, ICU and zlib for memory, databases, cryptography, authentication, text and compression. See the file inventory under licenses. Copyright belongs to the respective authors; each license applies independently."
"Applies immediately to speed updates on the sharing page and in notifications. Statistics include all device network activity. A longer interval does not limit transfer speed."
"Device-wide speed, not just sharing · Updated every %1$d s"
"Example: /storage/emulated/0/Download. The folder must exist and be accessible with root."
"Enter an absolute path starting with /. Control characters, %, and . or .. path segments are not allowed."
"Folder path saved. Stop and restart sharing to apply."
"Cannot access the shared folder. Check that the path points to an existing folder and verify root access."
"Requires SMB3 encrypted user connections. Disable guests and add an enabled user first. Encryption can still be negotiated when off. Restart sharing to apply."

"Built in; no switch is needed. Compatible clients can copy files within the same share without downloading and uploading them.\nThe client must request this feature. The destination needs write access, and copy speed depends on storage performance."
"Required encryption needs guests off and at least one enabled user."
"Configured: SMB3 encryption required; guest and unencrypted connections rejected."
"Configured: encryption is optional and negotiated by the client; guest sessions are not encrypted."
"Server-side copy: built-in COPYCHUNK support. Use depends on the client; write permissions still apply."
"Cannot read this folder. Check root access and, for external storage, that the drive is still connected."
"No subfolders. You can select this folder."
"Open a subfolder, then select Use this folder to confirm."
"Choose existing source and output folders. Keep external storage connected."
"Source and output folders cannot be identical or contain each other."
"Grant file access and ensure the source is readable and the output folder is writable. Auto archive does not use root to bypass permissions."
"Monitoring · waiting for new or changed items"
"Automatically compress new or changed items into the output folder. Each file or folder directly inside the source folder becomes a separate archive."

"Checks every 5 seconds and starts compression after sizes and modification times stay unchanged for 30 seconds. This does not guarantee that writing has finished.

Keeps source files and old archives. Changes in a subfolder cause its top-level folder to be archived again. Skips symbolic links and special files.

Stopping monitoring cancels unfinished tasks. Restart monitoring manually if Android terminates the app."

"XZ for Java 1.10: streaming LZMA2 compression for TAR.XZ; 0BSD. Apache Commons Compress 1.28.0: TAR packaging, with Commons IO / Lang / Codec dependencies; Apache 2.0. ZIP / Gzip use platform compression libraries."
"Off by default to reduce delays in showing files added on the phone. Enabling directory caching may delay updates. Restart sharing and reconnect the client after changing this setting."
"No users yet. Add a sharing account."
"Up to 32 independent accounts share the current folder with individual permissions. Legacy accounts are not imported. Passwords are encrypted using Android Keystore."

"Set user permissions in Manage users. The write switch affects guests only. When guests are enabled, unknown accounts receive guest permissions. Disabling or deleting a user does not block guest access. Some Windows security policies block guest connections."
"After saving account changes, stop and restart sharing to apply them."
"Add and enable a user, or allow guest access."
"Account operation failed. Check duplicate names, the 32-user limit and passwords. Reset any unreadable password."
"Delete %1$s? After sharing restarts this account cannot sign in. Files are kept. Guest access is unaffected."
"1–32 lowercase letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter. root, nobody and guest are reserved."
"1–256 characters without line breaks. Use a long, unique password."
"Leave blank to keep the password. New passwords are stored encrypted."
"Allow guests to upload, edit and delete"
"Could not create Samba user %1$s. Sharing was not started. See diagnostics below; this does not necessarily indicate a password problem."
